plays_when: An event map in Draklor Laboratory, field 854, each time the party opens a door in 67th Floor (Draklor Laboratory), field 1019: that map's script makes the door an actor and enables its talk (dor_a12 lines 2224 and 2230). The door's talk asks for a jump lock (lines 2235 and 2251; sysucoff returns 1 when a jump lock is set, else 0, verb-table-inputs.tsv). With a lock it clears the jump and stays (lines 2252 and 2254); with no lock it takes the party here, entrance 0 (lines 2257 and 2278). The talk tests no story counter, and no line of dor_a12 calls the door's functions that turn its talk off. Here the map's director, with no test, reads the scene and plays it (dor_z01 lines 69 and 73), waits for its end (line 74), sets the story counter to 3400 (After the forcible approach) (line 77) and takes the party to 67th Floor (Draklor Laboratory), field 1054, entrance 2 (line 99). Outside the developer scripts, the one jump in the us scripts that names this map's field id is dor_a12 line 2278, and the map-link table, which also lists the jumps the scripts reach through a variable (../Game-Files-And-Data-Tables/standard-file-formats.md), lists 67th Floor (Draklor Laboratory) as the way in (standard-file-formats-mapjump-nocrystal-rows.tsv).
